name: ECOMATE
recent: Ecomate 近期获得价值 RM16.66mil 的软件许可订单，并公布最新季度业绩，营收同比增长 96.5% 但净亏损扩大。公司也发布多项企业活动公告。
notable: 获得价值 RM16.66mil 的软件许可订单。
最新季度营收同比增长 96.5%，但录得净亏损 RM2.561mil。
risks: 最新季度净亏损扩大至 RM2.561mil，净亏损率为 14.4%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日季度，营收为 RM17.769mil，同比增长 96.5%，环比增长 13.2%；净亏损为 RM2.561mil，净亏损率 14.4%，较上季度的 7.4% 扩大。

recent_en: Ecomate recently secured a RM16.66mil software licence order and announced its latest quarterly results, with revenue up 96.5% year-on-year but net loss widened. The company also released several corporate announcements.
notable_en: Secured a software licence order worth RM16.66mil.
Latest quarterly revenue grew 96.5% year-on-year but recorded a net loss of RM2.561mil.
risks_en: Latest quarterly net loss widened to RM2.561mil, with a net loss margin of 14.4%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, revenue was RM17.769mil, up 96.5% year-on-year and 13.2% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was RM2.561mil, with net loss margin at 14.4%, widening from 7.4% in the previous quarter.
